description.name: Entry
description.text:
Tactical Awoken Mode, +500 ATK & +500 MAG to user
Tactical Awoken Mode: Lightning Ability Boost, Triplecast Lightning, Unlimited Lightning Hones, Cap Break Level 1 to Lightning Abilities, Lightning Ability Damage +30% & ATB Speed x1.1 to Lightning Abilities; Ends after using 8 Lightning abilities
TP Max: AOE Lightning/NE ranged hybrid attack at True Cap Break Level 1

description.name: War-Awoken Turks's Wonderbomb (Weapon Skill)
description.text:
Single-target Lightning/NE piercing ranged hybrid attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & ATB Speed x1.2 to Lightning Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold if target has at least 0/40% Imperil Lightning
WS Blue: Imperil Lightning 30% to all targets
WS Gold: DeProtect or DeShell 20% to all targets
